basic_details.job_title: Innovsource Services Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Executive Assistant, Executive Administrative Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview is on 10 December 2026, with reporting between 9:30 am and 11:00 am, at H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab- 140901. M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd, an outsourcing agency supplying manpower to the hospital on contract, is filling 2 posts: Executive Assistant (Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 60,000/-) and Executive Administrative Officer (Rs. 65,000/- to Rs. 75,000/-). This is a private contract job, not a direct government post.

content_sections.heading: About Innovsource Services
content_sections.text: M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Punjab, on contract. The walk-in interview is for deploying selected candidates at that hospital. The notice is dated 27.11.2026 and is signed by the Supervisor of the agency.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Age limit: Up to 40 years, as on the walk-in interview date. Knowledge: good working knowledge and skills of Microsoft applications (Word, Access, Excel, Power Point, and Outlook), including a good understanding and practical experience of using data bases, spreadsheet and the internet. Knowledge: understanding of financial spreadsheet in Excel. Skills: excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to use internet to research for materials; planning, priorities and time management skills. Skills: excellent logistical skills, making arrangement for travel, complex diary management; excellent interpersonal skills, dealing with people at senior levels professionally and with appropriate confidentiality. Experience: at least 3 years professional experience in similar capacity; experience of working under pressure in order to meet tight and changing deadlines. Attributes: a tactful, assertive and articulate voice able to interact effectively with a wide range of people from variety of cultural backgrounds and levels of seniority; ability to work to deadline by setting priorities and managing workloads. Age limit: Up to 45 Years, as on the walk-in interview date. Experience: 08 Years in the H.R.D / Administration dealing with General Administration, Estate management, Canteen & Cafeteria, Horticulture, Pest Control, Event Management, Industrial Relations etc. Skills: oversee daily office operations, manage administrative staff, ensure regulatory compliance, handle budget, procurement and tender process, hospital administration including preparing and managing data etc. Relaxation for upper age is given to persons belonging to Reserved Categories such as SC/ST/OBC, as per the instruction of Government of India. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notice also says norms can be relaxed for deserving candidates with relevant experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact post-wise eligibility.

rows.qualification: Post Graduation from recognized university, preferably MBA. At least 3 years professional experience in similar capacity.

Graduate With Post Graduate Management Degree/ Diploma in Human Resource Management / Labour Welfare / personnel Management / Industrial Relations / Health Administration. Experience of 08 Years in H.R.D / Administration.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to carry their Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and Educational and Experience Certificates in original and one set of self-attested copies. The notice lists these photocopies to be submitted at the interview: Resume and 2 recent passport size photographs (mandatory). Date of Birth proof: Birth Certificate / School leaving Certificate / 10th passing certificate. Educational qualification: Mark Sheet of all education documents and passing certificate for final examinations. Experience certificate for past employment, indicating the date of joining and relieving. For current employment: appointment letter and last pay slip. Copy of PAN Card and Aadhar Card. Original documents for verification purpose.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: In case of more candidates, an MCQ test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview accordingly. The agency reserves the right to fix a minimum eligibility standard or benchmark and cut-off marks (Group/Stream/Discipline/Category-wise etc.), and to restrict the number of candidates called for the written examination, interview or skill test, taking into account the number of vacancies and the percentage of marks in graduate and post graduate degrees. Merely fulfilling the prescribed qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called. The decision of the competent Authority is final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Contract Terms and Posting
content_sections.text: The post is initially for a fixed tenure of one year from the date of joining and may be extended subject to satisfactory performance and as per the institutional requirement. The posting will be at New Chandigarh or Sangrur as per institutional requirement. The advertised posts may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the institute.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Innovsource Services walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 December 2026 (10/12/2026), between 09.30 am and 11.00 am. Candidates will not be entertained before or after the scheduled date and time.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab- 140901.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Executive Assistant and 1 Executive Administrative Officer. The notice says the posts may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Executive Assistant?
faq.answer: Post Graduation from recognized university, preferably MBA, with at least 3 years professional experience in similar capacity. Good working knowledge of Microsoft applications is also listed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Executive Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: Graduate with Post Graduate Management Degree/Diploma in Human Resource Management / Labour Welfare / personnel Management / Industrial Relations / Health Administration, plus 08 years of experience in H.R.D / Administration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Executive Assistant: up to 40 years. Executive Administrative Officer: up to 45 Years. Age is counted as on the walk-in interview date, with upper-age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per Government of India instruction.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Executive Assistant gets Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 60,000/- and Executive Administrative Officer gets Rs. 65,000/- to Rs. 75,000/-, as printed under monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry Bio-data, 2 recent passport size photographs, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and educational and experience certificates in original along with one set of self-attested copies. Date of birth proof is also listed.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: If more candidates attend, an MCQ test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview. Mere fulfilment of qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called.

faq.question: Q10. Is the job permanent, and where is the posting?
faq.answer: The post is initially for a fixed tenure of one year from joining, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirement. Posting will be at New Chandigarh or Sangrur.
